title: SQL Functions
description: Test your knowledge of SQL functions for data manipulation

questions.question: Which function returns the average value of a numeric column?
questions.explanation: AVG() calculates the average value of a numeric column.

questions.question: What does the SUM() function do?
options: Adds up all values in a column
questions.explanation: SUM() adds up all the values in a numeric column.

questions.question: Which function returns the current date?
questions.explanation: CURRENT_DATE returns the current date in SQL.

questions.question: What does the CONCAT() function do?
questions.explanation: CONCAT() combines two or more strings into one.

questions.question: Which function extracts a substring from a string?
questions.explanation: SUBSTRING() extracts a portion of a string based on specified positions.

questions.question: What does the GROUP BY clause do?
options: Groups rows with the same values into summary rows
questions.explanation: GROUP BY groups rows with the same values into summary rows, often used with aggregate functions.

questions.question: Which function returns the highest value in a column?
questions.explanation: MAX() returns the highest value in a column.

questions.question: What does the HAVING clause do?
questions.explanation: HAVING filters groups after the GROUP BY clause is applied.

questions.question: Which function returns the length of a string?
questions.explanation: LENGTH() returns the number of characters in a string.

questions.question: What does the COALESCE() function do?
options: Returns the first non-NULL value in a list
questions.explanation: COALESCE() returns the first non-NULL value from a list of arguments.
